title: Scientific Revolution Deck

card.teaser: A playing card deck where Darwin, Lavoisier, Newton and Tesla are the kings.

summary: A playing card deck celebrating the Scientific Revolution, with Darwin, Lavoisier, Newton and Tesla as the kings.

hero.alt: Four illustrated king cards from a Scientific Revolution playing card deck.

overview.challenge: Merge historical accuracy with engaging visual design, turning educational content into a real deck that respects these legacies and still plays like normal cards.
overview.solution: Each suit is a field (biology, chemistry, physics and technology), with one of its pioneers as the king.
